# Project Context

## Overview
On-Call Hours Tracker — monorepo with two independent sub-projects.
- `backend/` — Spring Boot REST API
- `frontend/` — Nuxt 4 static SPA

---

## Detected stack

### Backend
- Language: Java 25 — evidence: `backend/pom.xml` (`<java.version>25</java.version>`)
- Framework: Spring Boot 4.0.6 (WebMVC, Data JPA, Validation, Flyway) — evidence: `backend/pom.xml`
- ORM / DB: Spring Data JPA + PostgreSQL; schema managed by Flyway — evidence: `backend/pom.xml`, `backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/`
- Code-gen: Lombok (compile-time) + MapStruct 1.6.3 (compile-time mappers) — evidence: `backend/pom.xml`

### Frontend

- Framework: Nuxt 4.4.5 + Vue 3 (SSR disabled — static SPA) — evidence: `frontend/nuxt.config.ts`

- Date/time inputs: `@internationalized/date` + `UInputDate` component, locale `enGB` (`dd/mm/yyyy`) — evidence: `frontend/app/app.vue` (per AGENTS.md)

### Infra / DevOps
- Containers: `docker-compose.yml` at repo root (full stack: backend + postgres + frontend)
- CI: `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml` (Java 25 Temurin, `./mvnw clean package -B -q -T 1C`), `.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml` (Node 26, `pnpm install` → `pnpm build` → `pnpm test`)

## Canonical commands

### Backend (run from repo root or `backend/`)
| Task | Command | Source |
|------|---------|--------|
| Build + test + format-check | `./mvnw clean package` | `backend/pom.xml` (spring-boot-maven-plugin + spotless:check) |
| Build (skip tests) | `./mvnw package -DskipTests` | `backend/pom.xml` |
| Single test class | `./mvnw test -Dtest=SomeUseCaseTest` | Maven Surefire |
| Fix formatting | `./mvnw spotless:apply` | `backend/pom.xml` (spotless-maven-plugin) |

### Frontend (run from `frontend/`)
| Task | Command | Source |
|------|---------|--------|
| Install | `pnpm install` | `frontend/package.json` (also runs `nuxt prepare` via postinstall) |
| Dev server | `pnpm dev` | `frontend/package.json` |
| Build (static SPA) | `pnpm build` | `frontend/package.json` |
| Lint | `pnpm lint` | `frontend/package.json` → `eslint .` |
| Typecheck | `pnpm typecheck` | `frontend/package.json` → `nuxt typecheck` |
| Test (all) | `pnpm test` | `frontend/package.json` → `vitest` |
| Test: unit only | `pnpm test:unit` | `frontend/package.json` → `vitest --project unit` |
| Test: nuxt only | `pnpm test:nuxt` | `frontend/package.json` → `vitest --project nuxt` |

> **Note:** CI does NOT run `lint` or `typecheck` — run these locally before pushing.

## Conventions

### Backend
- **Formatting:** Spotless + Palantir Java Format 2.90.0 (`PALANTIR` style); runs as `verify` lifecycle phase — evidence: `backend/pom.xml`. Build fails on wrong formatting; fix with `./mvnw spotless:apply`.
- **Testing framework:** JUnit 5 (via `spring-boot-starter-test`); test files match `*Test.java` pattern.
- **Architecture enforcement:** ArchUnit 1.4.2; `ArchitectureTest.java` enforces `domain → usecase → gateway` dependency direction. Do not violate.
- **DB migrations:** Flyway `V*__*.sql` in `backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/`. Never modify existing scripts — add new `V*` files only. Currently: `V1__create_schema.sql`, `V2__seed_data.sql`.

### Frontend
- **Linting:** ESLint 10 with `@nuxt/eslint`; stylistic rules: no trailing commas, `1tbs` brace style — evidence: `frontend/nuxt.config.ts`, `frontend/eslint.config.mjs`.
- **Typecheck:** `nuxt typecheck` (delegates to `.nuxt/tsconfig.json`); run `pnpm install` first if `.nuxt/` is missing — evidence: `frontend/tsconfig.json`.
- **Test projects (vitest):**
  | Project | Pattern | Environment |
  |---------|---------|-------------|
  | `unit` | `test/unit/*.{test,spec}.ts` | node |
  | `nuxt` | `test/nuxt/*.{test,spec}.ts` | nuxt + happy-dom |

## Project structure hotspots

### Backend (`backend/src/main/java/.../dutytracker/`)
- `domain/` — Pure domain entities and typed exceptions; no external dependencies
- `usecase/` — Business logic; sub-packages: request records, response records, validator classes
- `gateway/controllers/` — Spring MVC REST controllers; `GlobalExceptionHandler` maps domain exceptions to `ProblemDetail` (RFC 7807)
- `gateway/postgres/` — JPA entities, Spring Data repositories
- `gateway/holiday/` — `PublicHolidayGateway` interface + `JollydayPublicHolidayGateway` impl
- `infrastructure/` — Spring config beans, JPA converters
- `backend/src/test/java/.../usecase/` — Unit tests (no Spring context, no DB)
- `backend/src/test/java/.../gateway/controllers/` — `@WebMvcTest` slice tests

### Frontend (`frontend/app/`)
- `app/pages/` — Nuxt file-system routing (SPA)
- `app/components/` — Vue SFC components
- `app/composables/` — Reusable Vue composables
- `app/types/` — Shared TypeScript type definitions
- `app/utils/` — Utility functions
- `frontend/test/unit/` — Node-environment vitest tests (composables, utils)
- `frontend/test/nuxt/` — Nuxt+happy-dom component tests

## Observed patterns

- **DI (backend):** Spring constructor injection (Lombok `@RequiredArgsConstructor` implied by `val` usage); no manual wiring — evidence: `gateway/controllers/GlobalExceptionHandler.java`
- **Error handling (backend):** Domain exceptions thrown from use cases; central `@RestControllerAdvice` (`GlobalExceptionHandler`) maps each exception to typed `ProblemDetail` (HTTP RFC 7807) with structured `log.atWarn().addKeyValue(...)` — evidence: `gateway/controllers/GlobalExceptionHandler.java`
- **Logging (backend):** SLF4J via Lombok `@Slf4j`; structured key-value logging with `log.atWarn().addKeyValue("key", value).log("message")` — evidence: `gateway/controllers/GlobalExceptionHandler.java`
- **Configuration (frontend):** Runtime config via `NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE` env var (default `http://localhost:8080`); dev proxy `/api/*` → `http://localhost:8080/api` — evidence: `frontend/nuxt.config.ts`
- **DB / persistence:** Spring Data JPA repositories (gateway layer); MapStruct mappers translate between domain objects and JPA entities; Flyway manages schema versioning — evidence: `backend/pom.xml`, `gateway/postgres/`

---

## Notable quirks

- `ssr: false` in `nuxt.config.ts` — fully static SPA, no SSR. Only `/` is prerendered.
- **Date inputs:** Always use `UInputDate` (Nuxt UI v4) backed by `@internationalized/date`; never native `<input type="datetime-local">`. `UApp` in `app.vue` is configured with `locale="enGB"` enforcing `dd/mm/yyyy` and `granularity="minute"` for datetime fields.
- Lombok + MapStruct are annotation-processor compile-time only; do not hand-write what they generate. Both must appear in `maven-compiler-plugin` `annotationProcessorPaths` in correct order (`lombok` → `lombok-mapstruct-binding` → `mapstruct-processor`).
- Integration tests use **Testcontainers** (PostgreSQL); Docker must be running locally for `./mvnw clean package` to succeed.
- Frontend `tsconfig.json` delegates entirely to `.nuxt/tsconfig.json` (generated); run `pnpm install` before typechecking if `.nuxt/` is absent.
- No pre-commit hooks, no Makefile — all checks are per-command or enforced in CI.
